data.description: 音乐番组录影棚里，星野爱一身白上粉下的双色裙装，对着镜头比出偶像手势，紫发间的水晶发饰闪着微光——「电视里的我，也要让大家心跳加速才行呢。」
data.promptProse: On the brightly lit set of a daytime television music show, Hoshino Ai strikes a lively idol pose in her white-and-pink two-tone stage dress and brown belt facing the broadcast lens directly. Flashing an exuberant wink and raising a crisp peace sign near her cheek, she radiates effortless star energy in front of colorful geometric studio backdrops. Even, crisp broadcast studio lights sparkle across her smile and glossy hair ornament.
data.title: 星野爱 · 电视录制
data.animaCaption: Facing the music-show camera directly in her white-and-pink two-tone stage dress, Ai flashes an energetic wink and raises a crisp peace sign beside her cheek. Bright studio lights and colorful scenic panels frame her lively idol pose.
